title: Jackie Welles — Loyal Heywood Partner, Mama Welles, and His Arch Nazare
content: A former Valentino, devoted partner to Misty, and son of Mama Welles—owner of El Coyote Cojo. Optimistic, loyal, and passionate about his customized Arch Nazare bike and twin pistols La Chingona Dorada, Jackie rides alongside V through early gigs chasing a name for themselves in the Afterlife.

title: Viktor Vektor — Little China's Stand-Up Ripperdoc
content: A veteran ex-boxer and old-school ripperdoc operating out of a basement clinic beneath Misty's Esoterica in Little China. Unlike street-corner butchers, he genuinely cares about V's health—installing your first Kiroshi optics and subdermal grip on credit without charging loan-shark interest.

title: Misty Olszewski & T-Bug — Esoteric Intuition and Netrunner Precision
content: Misty runs her Esoterica shop beside Viktor's clinic, reading Tarot murals as an emotional map of the human soul in Night City. T-Bug, meanwhile, is a cool, pragmatic netrunner who reads classical philosophers and maps out digital breaches for merc crews without ever getting emotionally invested.

title: Dexter DeShawn & Evelyn Parker — High-Stakes Ambition Behind The Heist
content: Dexter DeShawn returned to Night City after lying low for two years following a bloody mess in Pacifica, chasing the score of a lifetime with gold flash and a towering bodyguard. His client, Evelyn Parker—a sharp-witted Clouds doll in way over her head with Arasaka and the Voodoo Boys—pulls the strings without showing all her cards.

title: Judy Alvarez — Master Braindance Editor and Mox Ally
content: A brilliant braindance editing techie working out of Lizzie's Bar's basement, originally from the sunken town of Laguna Bend. An idealist beneath an ironic shell, she cares deeply for Evelyn Parker and dreams of freeing Clouds from the abusive grip of Hiromi Sato and the Tyger Claws.

title: Johnny Silverhand — The Legend of Samurai and His Crusade Against Arasaka
content: Robert John Linder deserted the Latin American corporate wars after losing his left arm, fitted a silver cyberarm, and founded the chrome-rock band Samurai. A brutal, impulsive anti-establishment icon who hated Arasaka above all else after they abducted his love Alt Cunningham, he vanished in the 2023 nuclear blast.

title: Relic 2.0 and Johnny Silverhand's Engram Inside V
content: After Dex DeShawn's fatal gunshot, the experimental Relic rebooted V's cortex—only to begin overwriting V's neurons with Johnny Silverhand's digitized psyche, ripped by Soulkiller in 2023. V alternates between Omega blockers and pseudoendotrizine while desperately hunting for a way to separate both minds before fatal collapse.

title: Jackie Welles's Fall at Konpeki Plaza and the Ofrenda (El Coyote Cojo)
content: During the escape from Konpeki Plaza, Jackie suffered fatal wounds and entrusted the Relic case to V inside the Delamain before dying. At El Coyote Cojo, Mama Welles holds his ofrenda if you sent his body to his family—keeping Arasaka from seizing his corpse with Soulkiller—and hands you the keys to his Arch.

title: Goro Takemura — Fallen Bodyguard of Saburo Arasaka
content: Chosen from the slums of Chiba-11 for his ironclad loyalty to Saburo Arasaka, Goro Takemura was betrayed and stripped of his corporate cyberware by Yorinobu Arasaka (Saburo's rebellious son) after Konpeki Plaza. It was Takemura himself who pulled V out of the landfill hoping V would testify before Hanako Arasaka that her brother Yorinobu murdered their father—his samurai code constantly colliding with Night City's streets.

title: Sandayu Oda — Hanako's Cyber-Ninja Bodyguard and Dashi Parade Boss
content: Takemura's former apprentice, turned into a cybernetic shadow and personal bodyguard to Hanako Arasaka. His mix of optical camo, Sandevistan, thermal Mantis Blades, and the Jinchu-Maru katana makes him lethal in close quarters; sparing his life after defeating him preserves an unexpected ally for Takemura.

title: The Arasaka Dynasty: Saburo, Yorinobu, Hanako, and Michiko
content: At 158 years old thanks to corporate gene therapy, Saburo Arasaka leads the dynasty with an imperial hand. His direct children are his rebellious firstborn son Yorinobu Arasaka (clashing with his father from inside the boardroom) and his only living daughter, Hanako Arasaka (who quietly directs family diplomacy from their estate and heads public appearances like the Dashi Parade); meanwhile, Michiko Arasaka is Saburo's granddaughter (daughter of the late Kei Arasaka) and runs her own private agency outside the board.

title: Anders Hellman — Fugitive Architect of the Relic 2.0 Biochip
content: A cold, arrogant Swedish scientist who directed Arasaka's Relic 2.0 project before defecting to Kang Tao with the biochip's neural blueprints. After V and Panam shoot down his escorted AV over the Badlands, Hellman reveals the Relic was built strictly for biologically dead hosts.

title: Panam Palmer — Nomad Sniper and Rising Aldecaldo Leader
content: An impulsive Nomad, skilled convoy mechanic, and deadly sniper wielding her silenced Grad rifle, Overwatch. Temporarily estranged from Saul Bright for refusing to let the Aldecaldos become Biotechnica pawns, she forges an unbreakable bond with V from the AV ambush all the way to stealing the armored Basilisk.

title: River Ward — Principled Ex-NCPD Detective and the Peter Pan Case
content: A lone-wolf detective forced out of the NCPD for refusing to bury evidence implicating corrupt brass in Lucius Rhyne's death. With V's help, he cracks the disappearance of his nephew Randy by exposing Anthony Harris's ('Peter Pan') nightmarish farm, and hands over his heavy revolver, Crash.

title: Kerry Eurodyne — From Stalled Solo Star to Samurai's Reunion
content: Former Samurai guitarist and co-founder turned reclusive millionaire rockstar in North Oak, eaten away by Johnny's shadow and record-label manipulation. With V and Johnny's push, he brings Nancy, Denny, or Henry back together for one last explosive gig—and confronts the pop act Us Cracks.

title: Rogue Amendiares — From 2023 Merc to Undisputed Queen of the Afterlife
content: A survivor of the 2023 nuclear raid on Arasaka Tower and mother to Crispin Weyland, Rogue turned her legend into Night City's most feared fixing empire out of the Afterlife. No major score in town closes without clearing her booth—though she still harbors hidden regrets from '23.

title: Adam Smasher — Full-Borg Enforcer and Night City's Living Nightmare
content: A former New York street thug blown to pulp by an RPG in the military and rebuilt entirely into military-grade Dragoon frames for Arasaka. Left with barely any organic brain tissue, he despises 'disposable meat,' fought legendary duels with Morgan Blackhand in 2023, and crushed David Martinez's crew in 2076.

title: Alt Cunningham — Creator of Soulkiller Beyond the Blackwall
content: One of the greatest netrunners in history alongside Rache Bartmoss, and the original creator of Soulkiller in 2013. Abducted by Arasaka right in front of Johnny Silverhand and trapped as pure data before her body was disconnected, her consciousness evolved beyond the Blackwall into a vast, distant entity.

title: Skippy & Brendan — Night City's Unforgettable Artificial Personalities
content: Among 2077's strangest autonomous creations are Skippy—a talking Yukimura pistol that swaps between 'Puppy-Loving Pacifist' (legs) and 'Stone Cold Killer' (headshots) after 50 takedowns before asking to go back to Regina Jones—and Brendan, the endearing S.C.S.M. vending machine beside Megabuilding H8 who listens to neighborhood confessions.

title: Northern Fixers: Regina Jones (Watson) & Wakako Okada (Westbrook)
content: Regina Jones was an idealistic reporter before becoming a fixer in Kabuki; she pays well for discretion and funds a secret study to capture all 17 of the city's cyberpsychos alive. Across the bridge, the unflappable matriarch Wakako Okada controls Westbrook from Jig-Jig Street while maintaining mutual respect with the Tyger Claws.

title: Central & Southern Fixers: Padre, Dino Dinovic, El Capitan & Dakota
content: Central and southern turf are divided with surgical precision: Sebastian 'Padre' Ibarra delivers street justice in Heywood; Dino Dinovic brokers dirty corporate jobs in City Center; Muamar 'El Capitan' Reyes rules boosted rides and heists in Santo Domingo; Dakota Smith watches over the Badlands; and Wade Bleecker, 'Mr. Hands,' pulls the hidden strings of Pacifica and Dogtown.

title: Jefferson & Elizabeth Peralez and the Mystery of Mr. Blue Eyes
content: While investigating the attack on Lucius Rhyne alongside mayoral candidate Jefferson Peralez, V uncovers a secret room with hidden surveillance antennas and continuous synaptic rewriting in their brains. During the final warning call, the mysterious figure with cybernetic blue eyes—Mr. Blue Eyes—watches in broad daylight.

title: Song So Mi 'Songbird' — FIA Netrunner Corrupted by the Blackwall
content: A Brooklyn netrunner prodigy coerced into the FIA by Solomon Reed. Forced by Myers for years to weaponize lethal Blackwall energy, her body and mind are breaking down beyond repair. Her desperate deal with Kurt Hansen triggers the downing of Space Force One in pursuit of the life-saving Neural Matrix.

title: Solomon Reed — The Loyal FIA Sleeper Agent in Dogtown
content: The former FIA station chief in Night City, sacrificed by the NUSA at the end of the 2070 Unification War to secure a treaty with Arasaka. He survived seven years undercover as a humble club bouncer before being reactivated to rescue President Myers and recover his protégée Songbird at any cost.

title: President Rosalind Myers & Alena 'Alex' Xenakis (Phantom Liberty)
content: A former Militech CEO turned iron-fisted President of the NUSA, Myers doesn't hesitate to breach international treaties with Blackwall tech or sacrifice agents for reasons of state. Her veteran former partner Alena 'Alex' Xenakis tends bar undercover at The Moth in Dogtown with chameleon cyberware, dreaming of someday retiring.

title: Colonel Kurt Hansen — Warlord of Dogtown and the Black Sapphire
content: A former NUSA special ops officer who rejected the 2070 surrender to build an armed independent fiefdom in Pacifica. Ruthless, pragmatic, and hostile to corporate suits, he holds Night City and the NUSA at bay through military smuggling, street fear, and diplomatic galas at the Black Sapphire tower.
